text:
Maria (support): FYI customer in eu-west reported a spike of 502s + sporadic 504s on hosted API after the model push ~09:06 UTC. They call /v1/generate streaming with large prompts (~5-7k tokens). Trace ids attached.
Ken (SRE): copy. any repro yet? which upstream did envoy mark as failed?
Maria (support): sample trace: tx-9f3c5e (attached). Request id header: x-rdx-req: rdx-9f3c5e-01. Errors seen: UPSTREAM_RESET, UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT in frontdoor logs.
Jamie (eng): deploy-bot shows rdx-service@v2.3.4 rolled at 2026-03-19T09:06:32Z to canary pool
deploy-bot: deploy rdx-service@v2.3.4 triggered by jamie at 2026-03-19T09:06:32Z
Ken (SRE): checked edge metrics -> h2 streams per connection rose, keepalive pool nearing capacity on midproxy pods, connection churn + retries -> envoys returning 502 when upstream reset socket
Infra Ops: saw midfront 10.1.5.12 with many RSTs to backend, logs: "conn error: read: connection reset by peer", kernel tcp_tw_reuse high.
Lina (DevEx): customer reports long-lived chunked streaming. Workaround asked: reduce concurrency and chunk size.
Maria (support): repro plan: send 40 concurrent streaming requests with 6k token prompt and 2s chunk delay, measure gateway 502 rate.
Ken (SRE): I ran a quick stress: reproduced 502s in ~2m. Short logs:
```
[envoy] 2026-03-19T09:12:45Z upstream reset UPSTREAM_RESET tx=rdx-9f3c5e-01
[midproxy] 2026-03-19T09:12:46Z write error: broken pipe
```
Jamie (eng): hypothesis: model v2 increased per-token output time for long sequences -> streams remain open longer, holding backend worker slot -> connection pool exhausted + LB retries -> 502s. Also saw larger response headers for streaming metadata (extra x-model-meta entries).
Ken (SRE): temporary mitigations applied: bump nginx keepalive pool from 100 -> 250 on midproxy ASG, increase envoy upstream_max_requests to 200, and disable aggressive immediate retries for 502s on frontdoor.
Infra Ops: rolled config change through midproxy ASG around 09:28 UTC, watching.
Maria (support): customer still seeing intermittent 502s but much improved after change.
Jamie (eng): we rolled a rollback to rdx-service@v2.3.3 in the canary group at 09:34 and metrics dropped to baseline. Suggest follow-ups:
- add streaming-aware routing during model swaps (drain + weight ramp)
- enforce per-tenant streaming concurrency cap
- add server-side soft timeouts for long tokens
- capture full request/response header sizes in metrics
Ken (SRE): added urgent ticket to implement circuit breaker per-tenant to prevent pool hogging. Also will add an alert for long-lived h2 stream ratio > 10%.
Lina (DevEx): I'll pass recommended customer mitigations: reduce parallel streaming calls, split large prompts, or pin to stable model until we harden routing. I'll share a sample curl and small chunking code snippet.
Maria (support): customer updated: rollback fixed most of errors, asked for ETA on fixes. I'll keep them posted.
Jamie (eng): next steps: follow-up RFC for model-swap drain policy + load tests for long streams. I'll ping @oncall if we see recurrence.
Ken (SRE): closing immediate incident as baseline restored. Keeping the alert muted for 2h while we monitor.
Maria (support): thanks everyone :thumbsup:
notes: Repro steps, quick mitigation, rollback, follow-ups added
